The '''Panteer hideout''' was a small hideout owned by [[House Panteer]] and located in a cave on the west end of the [[Glarus Valley]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. In this hideout, were stationed Captain [[Lieber]], [[Darth Viktus]], [[Fixer 103]], General [[Gurveer]] and Lord [[Aurren Tuile Panteer]].
